function: Motor output frontend for multicopter and helicopter variants, including spool logic, thrust linearization, PWM protocol selection and battery-aware output scaling.
evidence: AP_MotorsMulticopter.cpp includes AP_BattMonitor, AP_Logger and uses AP_MOTORS_PARAM_PREFIX as MOT_ for Copter and Q_M_ for Plane.
AP_Motors_Thrust_Linearization.cpp includes AP_BattMonitor, AP_Baro and AP_AHRS and uses AP::battery() and AP::ahrs().
ArduCopter/Parameters.cpp exposes motors with prefixes MOT_ and H_.
AP_MotorsMulticopter.cpp declares parameters such as PWM_TYPE, SPIN_MIN, SPIN_ARM, BAT_IDX and OPTIONS.
AP_MotorsHeli.cpp and AP_MotorsHeli_RSC.cpp declare helicopter-specific parameters such as COL_MIN, COL_MAX, RSC_SETPOINT and RSC_MODE.
